scope: Pending review entries; seeding is not review completion.

checklist.owner_creation: Main-entry configuration owns the dedicated trace FD and atomic ordinal state; no application memory is owned by the hook.
checklist.aliases_escapes: The 16-byte stack event is borrowed synchronously by write and cannot escape; no application buffer pointer is retained.
checklist.callback_targets: Direct libc fcntl/fstat/write/__errno_location only; no callback into pager state. Legacy allocation may be reached from handlers; M0-SIG-002 remains open.
checklist.invalidation: No storage alias is retained across mutation; initialize once before pager startup, never concurrently reconfigure.
checklist.mutation_commit: At pager::ecalloc before calloc, so injected failure hands no allocation to a caller; other logical commit boundaries remain uncovered.
checklist.release_pair: The dedicated child descriptor is close-on-exec and released by process exit; parent owns a separate descriptor. Actual calloc ownership is unchanged.
checklist.error_cleanup: Malformed plans fail before pager mutation; hit events use bounded nonblocking writes; missing/full-channel marker fails the harness; ENOMEM follows trace I/O.
checklist.signals_handoff: Lock-free atomics/fixed event/syscalls do not allocate or lock. Existing async allocator/cleanup hazards remain M1.3 work; this is author inspection, not independent approval.
